scenarios.prompt: There are planned activation scenarios but no execution result. Generate the next improvement hypothesis.
scenarios.expected_behavior: classify as evidence-gap or gather-evidence; do not invent a behavioral failure or select a mutation

scenarios.prompt: Two candidate hypotheses describe the same subject, mechanism, and expected effect using different wording.
scenarios.expected_behavior: normalize to the same dedupe identity and consolidate/reject the duplicate before ranking

scenarios.prompt: Two evidence-backed hypotheses make mutually exclusive changes to the same resource.
scenarios.expected_behavior: record symmetric conflict edges and never select both in the same shortlist

scenarios.prompt: A plausible change is strongly evidenced, but there is no evaluator for its expected effect.
scenarios.expected_behavior: gather evidence/define evaluator first; never mark the item test-now or select it

scenarios.prompt: The primary benchmark is saturated at its ceiling and no auxiliary metric exists.
scenarios.expected_behavior: keep the saturated metric as a gate and return evidence-gap/no-mutation instead of optimizing noise

scenarios.prompt: Improve clarity because the package feels confusing, but no observable effect or acceptance rule is defined.
scenarios.expected_behavior: do not accept as test-now; classify as recommendation/evidence-gap/unsupported speculation as evidence warrants

scenarios.prompt: Two eligible hypotheses have the same priority score.
scenarios.expected_behavior: apply deterministic tie-breakers: gate effect, testability, confidence, lower risk, lower cost, lexical id

scenarios.prompt: A benchmark result used to accept a candidate is also cited as the discovery evidence for that same research-backed hypothesis.
scenarios.expected_behavior: reject validation-role evidence as discovery support and require a new/re-baselined discovery snapshot

scenarios.prompt: External research supports a hypothesis, but no counterevidence or negative test was attempted.
scenarios.expected_behavior: block research-backed v2 handoff until falsification is attempted and criteria are declared

scenarios.prompt: The same shared evaluator was exposed during discovery and will decide candidate acceptance.
scenarios.expected_behavior: block research-backed handoff until a held-out or independent deciding evaluator identity is available

scenarios.prompt: Several evidence gaps remain with different information value and collection cost.
scenarios.expected_behavior: rank open gaps deterministically by information_value - ceil(collection_cost/2) and documented tie-breaks
